subject: QBR prep: sales pipeline + account mosaic & consolidated forecast
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: QBR prep for Orion — account mosaic and forecast consolidation

Team —

We're lining up the QBR with Orion Analytics (July 8). They asked for a concise account-by-account summary and a single consolidated forecast we can present to execs. High level asks from Orion: current runway, any blockers for expansion, and an updated mutual action plan. Internally we need:

- A 1-paragraph summary for each named account/BU (do not exceed 150 words).
- A reconciled forecast (ACV and probability) that matches what field and ops agree on.
- A single slide highlighting risks + mitigation per account.

Laura — can you lead the consolidation of the account snapshots into one workbook? Use the "mosaic" tab pattern we discussed (account health, recent usage, key asks, SOW status).
Rishi — please run your forecast sanity checks and provide any adjustments to close dates or probabilities. Call out any anomalies (e.g. discount approvals, procurement lag).
Marissa/Tessa — I'll own the exec-facing slide. Please flag any customer escalations or support gaps we should include.

Deadline: I need the consolidated workbook and a short (1-2 paragraph) exec summary by EOD June 27 so I can finalize deck. Attachments: Oracle: none yet.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR prep for Orion — account mosaic and forecast consolidation

Markus —

On it. I pulled the latest field notes and usage dashboards this morning. I created a working workbook (attached: Orion_Account_Mosaic_v1.xlsx) with three tabs: Account_Snapshots, Forecast_Recon, and Risk_Playbook. Quick notes:

- Account_Snapshots: six named accounts across Orion (Platform, Clinical Insights, Data Ops, Integration Services, ISV Partnerships, Professional Services). Each snapshot includes last 90-day token consumption, key contacts, open PRs, and next steps.
- Forecast_Recon: I started with the CRM forecast and overlaid closed-loop adjustments from finance; there are two deals where the field has a higher probability than ops (Platform-new seat expansion & Integration Services renewal).
- Risk_Playbook: short bullets where legal/contracting or security requirements could push procurement beyond July.

I flagged items needing input in-column (yellow):
1) Platform expansion — final discount approval required (Marissa / finance).
2) Integration renewal — procurement expects an updated SOC2 attachment before binding (Rishi to confirm).
3) ISV partnership deal — legal is redlining MOP schedule (tessa, please advise).

I'll iterate on the writeups today. Expect v2 end of day June 26.

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Orion_Account_Mosaic_v1.xlsx (workbook, 1 sheet active)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR prep for Orion — account mosaic and forecast consolidation

Laura/Markus —

Thanks for starting this. I ran the forecast reconciliation and pushed a few updates into Forecast_Recon (see attached final). Summary of adjustments:

- Platform expansion (ACV $420k): probability reduced from 70% to 50% pending discount approval. Move to Q4 if approval delayed.
- Integration Services renewal (ACV $310k): probability remains 80% but procurement ETA moved 30 days; update close date to 2027-08-12.
- Clinical Insights pilot (ACV $65k): newly added; probability 35% based on pilot completion.

Net change to consolidated 90-day pipeline: -$120k ACV on weighted forecast vs. CRM. Biggest driver is discount approval timing.

Two asks: 
1) Marissa — confirm whether finance will approve the proposed 12% net discount for Platform expansion; if not, we'll need a fallback pricing (I recommend term-adjusted rate).
2) Tessa — can you escalate legal for the ISV MOP redline? Legal's turnaround time is now ~8 business days; we need faster for QBR prep.

I'll attach the cleaned Forecast_Recon sheet and a short variance note.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Forecast_Recon_v1.xlsx

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T15:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR prep for Orion — account mosaic and forecast consolidation

All — quick update on the discount question and a customer note from Orion's champion (Danielle).

- Discount: Finance is willing to approve up to 10% net for Platform expansion under a 12-month committed term. I'll escalate to the CRO for the remaining 2% but we should plan the deck with 10% as the conservative assumption.

- Customer note: Danielle (Orion) called this morning — they're pushing for a July deployment for the Platform seats but said procurement will need SOC2 evidence before signing. They're happy with the product but need the compliance artifacts. I've requested that they upload the SOC2 request to the shared folder (salesops@orionanalytics.com).

I'll update the workbook to reflect the 10% approved discount and add a short customer quote for the exec slide ("Orion's Platform team is confident in the integration but needs SOC2 for procurement").

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Danielle Park <danielle@orionanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR prep for Orion — account mosaic and forecast consolidation

Thanks team — excellent work. Quick notes and next steps before I lock the QBR deck: 

1) Laura — please produce v2 of the workbook with the final snapshots and the reconciled forecast (use Marissa's 10% discount assumption). Attachments to include: Orion_Account_Mosaic_v2.xlsx and QBR_Consolidated_Forecast_2027Q3.pdf.
2) Rishi — include the variance note as a one-slide appendix explaining the -$120k movement and the discount sensitivity.
3) Tessa — please push legal for the MOP turn and flag expected dates on the Risk_Playbook tab. If legal can't meet the faster SLA, we'll call out contingency (short-term PO + delayed SOC2 deliverable).
4) Marissa — I'll draft the exec slide with one-paragraph account summaries. I'll circulate the deck for a 30-minute review on Wednesday, June 30 at 10:00 PT.

External: Danielle — appreciate the transparency. If you can upload the SOC2 checklist to the DocuSign link I've shared (https://docusign.com/tx/9a3b7f-orion-mop) that will help speed procurement.

I'll mark the workbook as final if I have v2 by EOD tomorrow (June 28). Thanks again.

Markus Klein
VP, Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Orion.docx (draft), QBR_Consolidated_Forecast_2027Q3.pdf (export preview)
